summary: Reuse successful immutable web build probes so a previously built main does not prevent attribution and ejection of a breaking PR.

replay.detail: No data replay; versioned tree-cache identities re-evaluate prior unattributed failures.

compatibility.detail: Probe reuse requires an existing receipt matching the prepared commit revision; immutable publication guards remain unchanged.

downtime.detail: The existing served build remains available during integrator replacement.

manual.detail: Deployment owners must update the trusted integrator launcher revision and restart the integrator process.

recovery.detail: Build failure still retains the previous served build; no drop-list or state reset is required.
